description: gcc/testsuite/gcc.dg tests with dg-error (top level, torture, tree-ssa, ipa, atomic, sso, tls, cpp, special, debug, charset, weak, rtl, noncompile) that gcc itself rejects with an error at -w in its default dialect. PASS = the compiler under test exits with status 1 (a diagnostic); accepting the invalid program is the failure. <test>.c.gccerror holds gcc's first diagnostic. Driver rejectonly. Regenerate with tests/scripts/import_gcc_dg.py.
